nodes.question: What vital preventive measure is emphasized in the context of preventing the spread of viruses during the pandemic?
nodes.answer: Regular handwashing is emphasized as a vital preventive measure in preventing the spread of viruses during the pandemic.

nodes.question: Why can people in areas with water scarcity be more susceptible to the virus?
nodes.answer: People in areas with water scarcity or contamination may struggle to follow basic hygiene practices like handwashing, making them more susceptible to the virus.
